landing.heroSubtitle: Give your customers a reason to come back — a simple stamp card they join by scanning a code at your counter. No app to download, no sign-up forms, no new hardware.
landing.whatsappMessage: Hi! I run a café / shop and I’d like to try the loyalty program for my business.
landing.heroReassure: No app · No new hardware · Set up in minutes
landing.step1Body: Your staff taps once and shows a QR code at checkout — on the tablet you already have.
landing.step2Body: They scan with their phone camera. No app to install, no account to create. Their visit is counted instantly.
landing.step3Body: Every visit earns a stamp. When they hit the goal, they get their reward — and a reason to keep choosing you.
landing.whyRepeatBody: Loyalty programs turn one-time visitors into regulars. This one runs itself.
landing.whyDownloadBody: The number one reason loyalty programs fail is friction. Scanning a code takes five seconds — no app, no forms.
landing.whyHardwareTitle: Works on what you already own
landing.whyHardwareBody: If you have a tablet or phone at the counter, you’re ready. No new hardware to buy.
landing.whySetupBody: We get you running quickly, and your staff needs about thirty seconds of training.
landing.pricingTitle: Start free. Pay only if it works for you.
landing.pricingBody: Try it with your customers at no cost. Once you see regulars coming back, keep going with a simple monthly subscription — no long contracts, no setup fees. We’ll help you get started personally.
landing.pricingNote: We’ll set you up personally — no automated signup.
landing.metaTitle: Turn first-time customers into regulars — loyalty with no app, no hardware
landing.metaDescription: A simple stamp-card loyalty program for cafés, restaurants and shops. Customers join by scanning a code at your counter — no app, no sign-up forms, no new hardware. Start with a free trial.
